boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Trinity College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with current late-hours evidence from their official pages.

cards.title: South Whitney Pizza
cards.subtitle: 264 South Whitney St, Hartford
cards.notes: Check the posted hours, then order pickup or delivery from the restaurant’s online menu for an evening meal.
cards.short_summary: A Hartford pizza shop with late-night pickup and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: South Whitney Pizza lists hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: South Whitney Pizza | Pizza Menu and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 10:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Paul's Ranch House & Pizza
cards.subtitle: 3281 Main St, Hartford
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s ordering page to verify service and place a pickup or delivery order before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant listing food service through 1:00 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Paul’s Ranch House & Pizza lists daily hours from 7:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists the restaurant open daily from 7:00 a.m. until 1:00 a.m.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 312 Farmington Ave, Hartford
cards.notes: Start an online order and confirm the live store schedule for pickup, delivery, and availability before you go.
cards.short_summary: A Farmington Avenue pizza location with hours extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Hartford store page lists the location open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 312 Farmington Ave, Hartford
cards.access_notes: Official store page currently states the Hartford location is open until 1:00 a.m.; confirm service mode when ordering.

cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1180 Broad St, Hartford
cards.notes: Check the official delivery or carryout schedule, then place an order for pickup or delivery from the Broad Street shop.
cards.short_summary: Broad Street pizza shop with late nightly delivery and carryout schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery and carryout until 2:45 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays at this location.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza Broad Street, Hartford
cards.access_notes: Official page lists delivery and carryout until 1:00 a.m. most days, 1:45 a.m. Thursday, and 2:45 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 485 Flatbush Ave, Hartford
cards.notes: Confirm the current order options on the official page, then use dine-in, drive-thru, pickup, or delivery as available.
cards.short_summary: A Hartford Taco Bell that publishes 3:00 a.m. daily restaurant hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists dine-in and drive-thru hours from 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. daily at 485 Flatbush Avenue.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 485 Flatbush Ave, Hartford
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in and drive-thru open daily until 3:00 a.m.; check live ordering before departure.

cards.title: Wendy's
cards.subtitle: 306 Prospect Ave, Hartford
cards.notes: Use the official location page to verify restaurant, drive-thru, carryout, or delivery availability for your chosen time.
cards.short_summary: Prospect Avenue fast-food location with a published 3:30 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 3:30 a.m. daily at 306 Prospect Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10:00 a.m.–3:30 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Munchies Grill
cards.subtitle: 894 Maple Ave, Hartford
cards.notes: Review the restaurant’s online hours and menu, then order ahead for pickup or delivery if service is active.
cards.short_summary: Maple Avenue restaurant with late-evening and overnight food service listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Munchies Grill lists hours until 2:00 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and 24-hour service Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 5:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and open 24 hours Friday–Saturday; confirm the day’s service.

cards.title: Choice One Pizza
cards.subtitle: 24 New Britain Ave, Hartford
cards.notes: Check the official carryout or delivery hours and order directly before making this New Britain Avenue food stop.
cards.short_summary: A pizza and sandwich shop with late pickup and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Choice One Pizza lists carryout until 1:30 a.m. on Thursdays and Fridays.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists carryout and delivery until 1:00 a.m. most weeknights and 1:30 a.m. Thursday–Friday.

cards.title: West End Pizza
cards.subtitle: 495 Farmington Ave, Hartford
cards.notes: Use the official menu and ordering page to confirm carryout or delivery service before making an evening food run.
cards.short_summary: Farmington Avenue pizza shop with late nightly carryout and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: West End Pizza lists carryout and delivery until 3:45 a.m. Wednesday–Friday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists carryout and delivery until 2:45 a.m. Monday–Tuesday and Saturday–Sunday, and 3:45 a.m. Wednesday–Friday.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 1 Main St, East Hartford
cards.notes: Check the official store page for the live schedule, then use available dine-in, drive-thru, pickup, or delivery options.
cards.short_summary: East Hartford Taco Bell with published overnight hours and food-service options.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 a.m. daily and until 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1 Main Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 1 Main St, East Hartford
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours are separately posted.
